class.name: FellowTerrainLayer
class.description: A [FellowTerrain3D] layer: an albedo and a normal map tiled over the ground every [member texture_size] metres (seen from above, or from three sides with [member triplanar]), a tint and a roughness. Changing it updates the terrains that use it.

members.member: Multiplies the albedo texture (an sRGB colour, as a material's albedo colour).
The layer's albedo (white without one). With [member height_in_albedo_alpha], its alpha is the layer's height for [member FellowTerrain3D.height_blend].
If [code]true[/code], the albedo texture's alpha is the layer's height (0..1) for the height blend; otherwise the layer is flat (0.5).
The layer's normal map (OpenGL convention, as Godot imports normal maps; only its red and green channels are read).
The metres one repeat of the textures covers.
If [code]true[/code], the textures are projected from the three axes and blended by the ground's normal (for cliffs: no stretching on steep slopes), at three times the texture reads.
